gizmo.title: Chosewerera zolemba
gizmo.description: Malangizo, chiwonetsero ndi zofotokozera za web component, ndi mabatani okopera a HTML, import, npm ndi CDN.

configure.title: Fayilo ya deta ya zolemba
configure.description: Deta ya zolemba yomwe imabwera ndi chinthucho (lib/tag.docs.json).

configure.title: Ndondomeko ya zithunzi za malangizo
configure.description: Ndondomeko ya kayendedwe yomwe imabwera ndi chinthucho (tag.motion.json). Mwakufuna.

configure.title: Phunziro la kanema
configure.description: Kanema wachidule wonena za chinthucho (YouTube, Vimeo kapena fayilo ya kanema). Imalowa m'malo mwa kanema mu deta ya zolemba.

configure.title: Malangizo odziyambitsa okha
configure.description: Yambitsani malangizo pomwe chosewerera chawonekera. Sichigwira ntchito ngati wowerenga amakonda kayendedwe kochepa.

advanced.title: Mutu wa malangizo
advanced.description: Kwa zinthu zokhala ndi malangizo angapo, mutu woti utsegulidwe koyamba (mwachitsanzo add-blocks). Siyani chopanda kanthu kwa waukulu.

advanced.title: Ulalo wa chiwonetsero chamoyo
advanced.description: Komwe batani la Tsegulani gwero la chiwonetsero limapita. Mwachisawawa ndi foda ya chiwonetsero mu malo osungira.

advanced.title: Ulalo wa zolemba
advanced.description: Komwe batani la zolemba zonse limapita, mwachitsanzo tsamba lofanana la Learn HAX.
